title:
When a {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} is being added to new or existing case, pre-populate alert's parent facility in the forms and also disable the form field.
There are 4 ways in which Alert can be added to case.
1. From Alert Detail Page -> Uses the page param to get alert's parent facility.
2. From Alert Detail Side Panel -> Uses the Alert id from {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#selectedSidePanelEntityId}.
3. From All Alerts Grid Bulk Selection -> Uses any of the alert's parent facility
   NOTE: All alerts are validated to have same facility in {@link ValidateAlertsHaveSameFacilityEpic}.
4. From Asset Detail Alerts Grid -> Uses any of the alert's parent facility.
name: PrepopulateAlertFacilityInCaseFormEpic
